statement_candidate_en: Article 26 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights recognizes a right to education and provides for compulsory elementary education and free elementary and fundamental education.
web_check_note: UN Declaration text Article 26 available through official indexed UN page; original URL direct-fetch responded 403; still requires local archival capture.

statement_candidate_en: Article 13 of the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights recognizes the right of everyone to education and requires free compulsory primary education for States parties.
source_organization: International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights
web_check_note: Full ICESCR Article 13 available in OHCHR webpage.

statement_candidate_en: Article 28 of the Convention on the Rights of the Child recognizes the child’s right to education and identifies measures for compulsory free primary education, accessible secondary education, attendance and reduced drop-out.
source_organization: Convention on the Rights of the Child
web_check_note: Full CRC Article 28 available in UNICEF webpage.

statement_candidate_en: The UNESCO Convention against Discrimination in Education was adopted in Paris on 14 December 1960 and entered into force on 22 May 1962.
source_organization: UNESCO Convention against Discrimination in Education
web_check_note: UNESCO legal-affairs page confirms adoption and entry into force dates.

statement_candidate_en: UNESCO describes State duties concerning the right to education as respect, protect and fulfil, and uses availability, accessibility, acceptability and adaptability as essential features.
source_organization: UNESCO State obligations and responsibilities on the right to education
web_check_note: UNESCO State-obligations page describes respect/protect/fulfil and four essential features.

statement_candidate_en: UNESCO Institute for Statistics SDG 4 framework includes distinct indicators for completion, out-of-school status, learning proficiency, parity and education finance.
source_organization: UNESCO Institute for Statistics SDG 4 Indicators
web_check_note: UNESCO UIS SDG 4 indicator page lists indicator definitions and metadata. Validate each metric separately.
